english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person, group, or force showing ill will or an enemy-like attitude.
Use this when the confrontational quality is mainly a hostile attitude rather than active provocation.

examples.english: Those people are very hostile toward new immigrants.
examples.traditional: 嗰班人對新移民好有敵意。
examples.jyutping: go2 baan1 jan4 deoi3 san1 ji4 man4 hou2 jau5 dik6 ji3

examples.english: Their tone was confrontational; I was only asking the time.
examples.traditional: 佢語氣有敵意，我只係問句時間啫。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 jyu5 hei3 jau5 dik6 ji3 ngo5 zi2 hai6 man6 geoi3 si4 gaan3 ze1
